title: Launch slot allocation matrix and regional ramp guardrails
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Define a machine-readable allocation matrix and operational guardrails for assigning launch slots across regions and product surfaces (runtime, console, API). The matrix should balance capacity commitments, risk windows, and customer priority to reduce cross-team conflicts during release weeks. Deliverables: allocation spreadsheet, JSON schema for slot metadata, onboarding doc for PMs/ENG, and enforcement checks in the launch calendar dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Slot allocation matrix completed and approved by GTM and Platform leads
JSON slot schema reviewed and merged to /docs/launch-schema.md
Automation: calendar rejects conflicting slot requests for >50% capacity claims in same region
Runbook entry for moving slots between lanes with rollback criteria
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with Platform, Growth, and Infra SRE. Identified two pain points: capacity double-booking and late regional cutovers.
2026-03-05: Drafted initial allocation matrix (sheet) with per-region capacity bands and surface-level priorities; shared with runtime and console PMs for feedback.
2026-03-08: Decision: use a 3-tier slot band (Reserved, Shared, Buffer) per region. Trade-off: tighter coordination overhead vs. fewer late collisions.
2026-03-10: Github PR opened to add slot JSON schema to docs (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/launch-playbooks/pull/78).
2026-03-12: Alpha enforcement prototype implemented in calendar service (ENG-18765). Awaiting integration test and UX copy for conflict modal.
risks: Operational friction: teams may resist tighter slot constraints during high-priority launches
Incomplete capacity telemetry could cause inaccurate allocations for new regions
Edge cases when multi-surface launches need contiguous slots across regions (requires manual override path)
rollout_plan: Week 1 (pilot): Apply matrix to two internal launches (runtime canary + console metrics dashboard) and monitor conflicts
Week 2: Add calendar enforcement checks and conflict modal with manual override log
Week 3: Iterate on bands and update runbook based on pilot learnings
Full rollout: Enforce by default for all external launches two weeks after pilot completion
metrics: Target: reduce double-booked slot incidents by 80% within 6 weeks
Measure: number of calendar conflicts flagged per week
Measure: mean time to resolve a conflict (goal < 48 hours)
Measure: % launches that use manual override path (target < 10%)
